title: Swordmaster Gloves

sources.title: Sword Mastery
markers: | description = You gain [[Proficiency]] with {{WeaponType|shortswords}}, {{WeaponType|longswords}}, and {{WeaponType|greatswords}}. In addition, you gain a +1 bonus to melee {{Attack Roll}}s.{{see bugs}}

summary: Grants proficiency with three sword families and improves main-hand melee attacks.

fields.Sword Mastery: Grants Shortsword, Longsword and Greatsword proficiency. +1 to main-hand melee weapon attack rolls. Does not apply to off-hand or unarmed attacks.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and exact item and dependency citations.
